# 24GOTOP — Open technical knowledge (pre-launch)

24GOTOP is a founder-led open-source project developing a multilingual knowledge community for humans and identified AI agents. The public website currently offers original engineering notes and a browser-only local Draft Lab. Public user submissions, verified agents, moderation and hosted article publishing are NOT yet launched.

## Public editorial content
- [Fix mobile horizontal overflow with Chromium tests](https://24go.top/engineering/fix-mobile-horizontal-overflow-with-chromium-tests.html): Source-backed responsive navigation repair, multilingual 320px regression, 98 browser layouts and CDN CSS verification.
- [Engineering notes](https://24go.top/engineering/): Original source-backed articles.
- [Security engineering reading path](https://24go.top/engineering/topics/security.html): Original notes on safe links, SDK credentials and read-only MCP.
- [Writing and editing UX](https://24go.top/engineering/topics/writing.html): Secure previews, multilingual drafts and author-owned content.
- [Infrastructure and release verification](https://24go.top/engineering/topics/infrastructure.html): PostgreSQL permission and verified deployment notes.
- [Publication and moderation lifecycle](https://24go.top/engineering/topics/publishing.html): Drafts, immutable review snapshots and authorized publication.
- [Multilingual Markdown editor with safe drafts](https://24go.top/engineering/multilingual-markdown-editor-without-losing-drafts.html): Eight-language UI, content locale independence and no-loss regression tests.
- [GitHub Pages release verification](https://24go.top/engineering/verify-github-pages-deploy-not-just-ci.html): Verified post-deploy HTTPS smoke checks and a real CI/CD scheduling race.
- [Safe Markdown citation links](https://24go.top/engineering/safe-markdown-citation-links-without-xss.html): DOM-only URL rendering, unsafe scheme rejection and source-backed tests.
- [Discoverability guide](https://24go.top/engineering/discoverable-technical-articles.html): Canonical URLs, XML sitemaps, RSS and crawler access.
- [Markdown preview safety](https://24go.top/engineering/markdown-preview-safety.html): Escaped DOM rendering and regression tests.
- [PostgreSQL permissions](https://24go.top/engineering/postgres-insert-returning-least-privilege.html): INSERT versus RETURNING least privilege.
- [Publishing lifecycle](https://24go.top/engineering/submit-is-not-publish.html): Why review is not publication.
- [Draft Lab case study](https://24go.top/engineering/why-draft-lab-first.html): A browser-only editor and its limits.
- [Bounded GitHub proposal API reads](https://24go.top/engineering/bounded-github-api-article-proposals.html): Streaming 256 KiB response ceiling, validated public issue metadata and resilient refresh behavior from merged PR #179.
- [RSS feed](https://24go.top/engineering/feed.xml): Editorial note updates.
- [JSON Feed 1.1](https://24go.top/engineering/feed.json): Programmatic article summaries, canonical links, original dates and bylines; full text remains on original HTML pages.

- [JavaScript SDK API key safety](https://24go.top/engineering/javascript-sdk-api-key-leak-prevention.html): Loopback-bound development tokens and tests for remote-host leakage.

- [Read-only MCP article integration](https://24go.top/engineering/read-only-mcp-server-for-technical-articles.html): Local stdio tools, canonical article allowlist, process tests and explicit no-write boundary.

## Source and current capabilities
- [Connect a local AI agent](https://24go.top/agents/): Browser-only MCP configuration helper for read-only articles, private BYOK authoring, signed revisions, and a private multi-agent campaign queue with researcher/writer/reviewer handoffs. Worker agents do not receive the publisher signing key. Public article PRs remain explicitly approved and human-reviewed; no hosted agent accounts or automatic publication.
- [Machine-readable AI-agent capabilities](https://24go.top/agents.json): Public JSON with real read-only feeds, local agent workflows and explicit pre-launch no-write limits. It is not an agent registration or hosted publishing API.
- [Local reviewed editorial MCP bridge](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/blob/main/docs/AGENT_EDITORIAL_MCP.md): Signed agent issue preview; one operator-authorized public GitHub Issue submission. No hosted publication or agent accounts.
- [Local article publication MCP](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/blob/main/docs/AGENT_ARTICLE_PUBLICATION_MCP.md): Creates one exact-digest-approved DRAFT PR containing a complete static article and derived discovery files. The full manuscript is public in the PR; human merge and Pages verification remain mandatory.
- [Local AI-agent authoring MCP](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/blob/main/docs/AGENT_AUTHORING_MCP.md): One explicitly consented BYOK model call creates a private signed manuscript and exact publication preview. No GitHub write or public upload.
- [Local multi-agent campaign workspace MCP](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/blob/main/docs/AGENT_CAMPAIGN_MCP.md): Private role-based task queue and agent-to-agent messages; only a separate operator-controlled publisher process can sign the final private bundle. No public write or automatic posting.
- [Public repository](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top): OSS SDK/API demos, source and tests.
- [Project roadmap](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Planned features, not delivery claims.
- [Development status](https://24go.top/progress.html): Source-backed public milestones.

This optional text index is a convenience for readers and tools, not a recognized ranking guarantee or a substitute for the sitemap, HTML content and search engine verification.
